questions.question: Sami asks Mina: 'What is the key to good pediatric care?' Mina replies:
options: Communication adapted to the child's age
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Communication adapted to the child's age is the key to cooperation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will adapt my language.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When should a child start visiting the dentist?' Mina replies:
options: At 6 years for the first molars
From the eruption of the first tooth or before 1 year
At 3 years for a first consultation
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The first visit should take place before 1 year or from the eruption of the first tooth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will offer early consultations.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the material of choice for a restoration on a baby tooth?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Glass ionomer releases fluoride and is well tolerated on baby teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use glass ionomer.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an anxious child in the office?' Mina advises him:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Tell-show-do is the reference method in pedodontics to reduce anxiety.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use this method.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is pit and fissure sealant and when should it be done?' Mina replies:
options: A resin applied to molars after eruption
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pit and fissure sealant is indicated from the eruption of the first permanent molars.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will offer sealants to my young patients.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to prevent early childhood caries?' Mina replies:
options: Educate parents on diet and hygiene
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Prevention involves educating parents on diet and hygiene.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train parents.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a pulpotomy?' Mina explains:
options: Partial removal of the coronal pulp
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pulpotomy preserves the radicular pulp and the baby tooth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will perform pulpotomies to save teeth.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When should a baby tooth be extracted?' Mina replies:
options: When it hinders the eruption of the permanent tooth
Always when the child is in pain
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Extraction is only indicated if the baby tooth hinders the eruption of the permanent tooth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate before extracting.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the signs of normal tooth eruption?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Tooth eruption can be accompanied by mild signs like irritability and increased salivation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will reassure parents.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is the eruption sequence of permanent teeth?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The first molars (6-year molars) erupt before the permanent incisors.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll remember the sequence!'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage an ankylosed baby tooth?' Mina advises him:
options: Monitor and evaluate the impact on permanent eruption
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Ankylosis may require extraction if it blocks permanent eruption.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor with X-rays.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is preventive dentistry in children?' Mina replies:
options: Measures to prevent the occurrence of caries and malocclusions
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Preventive dentistry includes hygiene, nutrition, fluoride, and sealing.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will promote prevention.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When should early orthodontics be considered?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'An early orthodontic evaluation around 7 years can detect severe problems.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer children to the orthodontist.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a cheek bite in a child?' Mina replies:
options: Check the occlusion and sucking habits
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Cheek bites are often linked to malocclusions or habits.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the occlusion.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a space maintainer?' Mina explains:
options: An appliance to maintain space after extraction
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The space maintainer is essential to prevent crowding problems.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will place space maintainers after extractions.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of preformed pediatric crowns?' Mina replies:
options: They protect the tooth and maintain space
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Preformed crowns (steel or aesthetic) protect the tooth and space.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use preformed crowns.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a baby tooth with a deep cavity?' Mina replies:
options: Evaluate if a pulpotomy or a crown is indicated
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A deep cavity may require a pulpotomy or a crown.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate before deciding.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a baby tooth with a fistula?' Mina replies:
options: Treat or extract according to the extent of the infection
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A fistula indicates a deep infection that requires treatment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a pulpotomy or extract.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the recommended fluoride dose in children?' Mina replies:
options: Variable according to age and caries risk
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The fluoride dose should be adapted to age and caries risk.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will assess the risk before prescribing.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an avulsed baby tooth?' Mina replies:
options: We do not try to replant baby teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Unlike permanent teeth, avulsed baby teeth are not replanted.' 🦅 Sami: 'I didn't know, thank you Mina!'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the risk factors for early childhood caries?' Mina replies:
options: Nighttime bottle-feeding and frequent sugary diet
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Early childhood caries is linked to dietary habits and hygiene.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will educate parents on these risks.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a child with a sucking habit?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Gradual cessation of sucking habits is recommended before 4 years.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will advise gradual cessation.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is restorative dentistry in children?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Restorative dentistry in children aims to preserve baby teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will restore rather than extract.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a baby tooth with an interproximal cavity?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Interproximal cavities on baby teeth must be restored.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a restoration.'

questions.question: Sami, after having mastered pediatric care with Mina, says: 'I am ready to treat all children!' Mina concludes: 'Mastering pediatric care is...'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mastering pediatric care is the basis of preventive dentistry.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to train.'
